name: m1k3
description: M1K3 inside Claude Code: the CLAUDE.md nevers as enforced tool.call rules (a direct push to master, a Write over the append-only session memory, hf download, defaults write app.m1k3, tell application id "app.m1k3"), M1K3's voice for the moments a session needs you (a permission prompt, an idle prompt, a long turn ending) through the app's own MCP server, and M1K3's avatar in the band above the prompt reacting to the session: the pixel face as a Raster (half-blocks) or an Svg, or the fox companion from baked sprite frames as an Image (kitty, Ghostty), a braille Raster (any terminal) or an SMIL Svg (desktop). /face hides and shows the band; /companion picks face, fox, phosphor or off.

voice.title: Speak through M1K3
voice.description: Have the live M1K3 app say when a session needs you or finishes a long turn. Off, those lines are toasts.

avatar.title: Avatar in the band
avatar.description: Which avatar the band above the prompt shows until /companion changes it: the pixel face, the fox, the phosphor fox, or none.
